compress.description: Enable Huffman compression for the hidden message.

line_length.description: Maximum line length in characters. Hidden whitespace is appended to ensure lines do not exceed this.

password.description: Password for ICE encryption. If empty, no encryption is applied.

quiet.description: Suppress statistical output (compression percentage, capacity used).

operation.description: Operation mode: 'conceal' to hide data, 'extract' to reveal data.

message.description: Inline message string to conceal. Mutually exclusive with message_file.

message_file.description: Path to file containing the message to conceal. Mutually exclusive with message.

input_file.description: Path to the text file to process. Used as source for extraction or container for concealment.

output_file.description: Path to write the result. If empty, writes to stdout.
